req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should auto-generate a unique integer ID for each new task, ignoring any client-supplied IDs. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_auto_generated_id
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid task payload.
expected: The response payload contains a unique integer ID for the task.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "A task for testing", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert isinstance(response_data["id"], int)
assert response_data["title"] == "Test Task"
assert response_data["description"] == "A task for testing"
assert response_data["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_with_client_supplied_id
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task payload containing a client-supplied ID.
expected: The client-supplied ID is ignored and a new unique integer ID is generated.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"id": 999, "title": "Test Task", "description": "A task for testing", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert response_data["id"] != 999
assert isinstance(response_data["id"], int)
assert response_data["title"] == "Test Task"
assert response_data["description"] == "A task for testing"
assert response_data["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_case
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task payload having the minimum valid title length.
expected: The response payload contains a unique integer ID for the task.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "T", "description": "Boundary test", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert isinstance(response_data["id"], int)
assert response_data["title"] == "T"
assert response_data["description"] == "Boundary test"
assert response_data["completed"] is False
